name: single leg glute bridge with knee to chest
description: One leg glute bridge where the free knee is hugged toward the chest. It strengthens the glutes and challenges hip stability.
instructions: Lie on your back with one knee bent and the foot flat, the other knee pulled toward your chest.
Push through the planted heel and lift your hips.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower slowly, finish the reps, then switch legs.
